verdict.rationale: TruffleHog includes an enterprise platform with hosted and self-hosted scanners, a web UI, and webhook integrations, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair thing to ask for. The evidence shows no such spec: probes of every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The only documented interfaces are the CLI and a webhook POST used for custom-detector verification, neither of which is a downloadable API spec.
